amendment: 02 - fail closed on duplicate active DID routes

owner_approval.scope: Start a fresh governed run requiring exactly one active SIP deployment match for each DID route.

problem_statement: The phone option value is not globally unique across active SIP deployments. A single-row DID lookup can therefore select an arbitrary assistant and tenant when duplicate active records exist.
acceptance_criteria: A DID route query evaluates all active SIP deployment matches before selecting tenant or assistant.
Zero matches return route not found.
Exactly one match supplies tenant, assistant, and CallAddress.To.
Multiple matches fail closed as ambiguous configuration before authentication context creation.
Database row order cannot affect DID route selection.
Duplicate DID tests cover different assistants in one tenant and assistants in different tenants.
No schema migration or uniqueness constraint is introduced.
All URI and phone separation requirements from the rewritten RFC remain unchanged.
non_goals: Add a database uniqueness constraint for phone option values.
Choose one duplicate record by creation date, identifier, tenant, or database order.
Expose duplicate tenant or assistant details to the SIP caller.
Expand the previously approved implementation scope.

design.did_lookup: Query active SIP deployments and phone options for the exact route value with a result limit sufficient to distinguish zero, one, and multiple matches.
design.one_match: Validate the phone grammar, resolve scope from that record, and set CallAddress.To.
design.multiple_matches: Return a generic ambiguous-configuration SIP failure before creating authentication context or loading an assistant.
design.observability: Emit route_kind=did and phone_result=ambiguous without raw phone, tenant, assistant, or URI values.

principles.kiss: Detect at most two DID matches because only zero, one, or multiple affects behavior.
principles.yagni: Do not add a schema constraint or repair existing records in this change.
principles.single_ownership: Route middleware owns duplicate detection before scope selection.
principles.single_source_of_truth: The complete active DID match set determines whether routing is safe.
principles.fail_safe: Any duplicate active DID state rejects the call rather than selecting a record.
principles.observability: Report only bounded ambiguity state and route kind.
principles.least_privilege: No tenant or assistant context is chosen until uniqueness is proven.
principles.reversibility: Revert the bounded lookup and duplicate tests with the complete SIP implementation.

risks: Existing duplicate DID configuration will begin failing closed instead of routing nondeterministically.
An unbounded query could waste resources, so implementation should fetch no more than two matches.
Creating authentication context before duplicate detection would preserve the cross-tenant risk.
Diagnostic logs could leak tenant or phone data unless bounded attributes are enforced.
required_tests: zero DID matches return route not found
one DID match resolves the expected assistant and tenant
two active matches for different assistants in one tenant fail closed
two active matches across tenants fail closed before authentication context creation
inactive duplicate records do not create ambiguity
duplicate failure observability contains no raw phone, tenant, assistant, or URI values
rollback: Revert duplicate detection together with the complete SIP URI and phone implementation. No schema rollback or data repair is required.
